title: Nobiletin ameliorates rheumatoid arthritis inflammation via suppression of the IL-17/NF-kappaB/MMP9 pathway.
authors: Jiang, Jing; Jiang, Meng-Ying; Huang, Meng; Hu, Yi-Rong; Deng, Hui; Li, Tian-Cai; Yang, Min; Chen, Jian-Lin; Sun, Wen-Kui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究柑橘黄酮Nobiletin通过IL-17/NF-kappaB/MMP9通路缓解类风湿关节炎炎症，仅涉及分子对接和信号通路蛋白表达，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a chronic autoimmune disease characterized by synovial proliferation and inflammatory infiltration. Nobiletin (NOB), a citrus-derived flavonoid, exhibits diverse pharmacological activities including anti-inflammatory and anti-cancer effects. Nevertheless, its therapeutic potential and mechanisms in RA remain largely unexplored. This study aimed to explore the potential targets and molecular mechanisms of NOB in the treatment of RA. We evaluated the effects of NOB on joint swelling and pathology in CIA mice, and assessed its impact on the proliferation, migration, apoptosis, and inflammatory factor expression of RA-FLS. Network pharmacology and molecular docking analyses suggested favorable binding affinity of NOB to key proteins. Finally, RA-FLS were treated with recombinant IL-17A protein to observe the reversing effects of NOB on cell phenotype and signaling pathways. In the CIA mouse model, NOB reduced paw swelling and suppressed synovial hyperplasia and inflammatory responses, accompanied by decreased expression of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and MMP9. In RA-FLS cells, NOB suppressed proliferation and migration, induced arrest at the G2/M phase, and promoted apoptosis via upregulation of Bax/Caspase-3 and downregulation of Bcl-2. It also modulated cytokine expression by increasing the levels of IL-4 and IL-10 while decreasing those of IL-6, IL-17, MMP1, and MMP3. Mechanistically, network pharmacology and Western blotting validation suggested that NOB may act through the IL-17/NF-kappaB/MMP9 axis, inhibiting IL-17A, TRAF6, p-p65, and MMP9 in a concentration-dependent manner. This effect was partially counteracted by IL-17A recombinant protein, thereby supporting the potential involvement of this pathway in NOB's effects. In conclusion, NOB alleviates the inflammatory pathological response in CIA mice and improved the phenotypic alterations of RA-FLS cells. These therapeutic effects may be mediated, at least in part, through the modulation of the IL-17/NF-kappaB/MMP9 signaling pathway. Collectively, our findings provide a theoretical basis for further investigation of NOB as a potential therapeutic agent for RA.
abstract_zh: 类风湿关节炎（rheumatoid arthritis, RA）是一种以滑膜增生和炎症浸润为特征的慢性自身免疫性疾病。川陈皮素（Nobiletin, NOB）是一种源自柑橘类水果的黄酮类化合物，具有多种药理活性，包括抗炎和抗癌作用。然而，其在RA中的治疗潜力和机制仍 largely 未被探索。本研究旨在探讨NOB治疗RA的潜在靶点和分子机制。我们评估了NOB对胶原诱导关节炎（CIA）小鼠关节肿胀和病理的影响，并检测了其对RA-FLS细胞增殖、迁移、凋亡及炎症因子表达的作用。网络药理学和分子对接分析表明，NOB与关键蛋白具有良好结合亲和力。最后，用重组IL-17A蛋白处理RA-FLS细胞，观察NOB对细胞表型和信号通路的逆转作用。在CIA小鼠模型中，NOB减轻了爪肿胀，抑制了滑膜增生和炎症反应，同时降低了TNF-α、IL-1β和MMP9的表达。在RA-FLS细胞中，NOB抑制了增殖和迁移，诱导G2/M期阻滞，并通过上调Bax/Caspase-3和下调Bcl-2促进凋亡。它还通过增加IL-4和IL-10水平、降低IL-6、IL-17、MMP1和MMP3水平来调节细胞因子表达。机制上，网络药理学和Western blotting验证提示，NOB可能通过IL-17/NF-κB/MMP9轴发挥作用，以浓度依赖性方式抑制IL-17A、TRAF6、p-p65和MMP9。这一效应被IL-17A重组蛋白部分逆转，从而支持该通路可能参与NOB的作用。总之，NOB减轻了CIA小鼠的炎症病理反应，并改善了RA-FLS细胞的表型改变。这些治疗效应可能至少部分通过调节IL-17/NF-κB/MMP9信号通路介导。综合来看，我们的发现为进一步研究NOB作为RA潜在治疗药物提供了理论基础。
